Name: Letters From Cameron
Author: DraconicArcher
Description:
Did you have any friends before moving to Pelican Town? It seems not in vanilla, just one parent that sends a couple letters.

[b]Letters from Cameron[/b] gives you a connection to your past life. Cameron is an old coworker who considers you a friend. Cam sends you periodic letters about office gossip and their life. Follow Cam's story through the letters.

There are 60+ letters over 5+ years

CW: References to drug use

Installing mid-save will cause a bunch of letters to pile up, resulting in one a day, and your anniversary letters will be on the wrong days, but you won't miss anything unless you've completed the community center.
